column1: # guard_allow.tsv: findings the render guard (Tools/render/guard.lua) lets pass, one per line, tab-separated:
# owner scope, scene glob, kind (ellipsis or outside), subject (its start, or = and the whole subject), reason.
# The owner is the round-3 fix scope that owns the defect (rank/FIX_R3_SCOPES.md: R1 to R7); the PR that fixes it
# deletes its lines, and shoot.sh --strict fails on a line that no longer matches. "design" marks a deliberate
# straddle the guard cannot tell from a spill (a tab or a coin set on a card's edge); it is not a defect.
